transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you here today?

Well, I came in because... lately, I just can't stop staring at this one part of my face. I'm an event planner, so I've had to be more in front of people at work recently, and there are always photos being taken. When I look at them, all I can see is how uneven this one area looks. It's really bothering me, even though everyone else tells me they barely see anything at all.
Can you tell me more about how you feel about this part of your face? Are you mainly concerned about this one area, or do you feel self-conscious about other parts of your appearance as well?

I guess... I'm really just focused on my nose right now. It's the main thing that bothers me. I mean, I notice other things sometimes, but it's the unevenness of my nose that I just can't get past. It feels like it's the only thing people see when they look at me, especially in those photos.
Does this concern about your nose cause you a lot of distress or interfere with your work, social life, or other daily activities?

Yeah, it does cause problems. Actually, I recently missed part of a planning deadline at work. I just... I spent so much time obsessing over how my nose looked in the event materials and photos that I fell behind. And now, even just doing normal tasks like vendor calls or prepping for meetings... it takes me a lot longer than it should because I'm so distracted by it.
Do you find yourself trying to cover up or hide your nose, like with makeup, clothing, or by avoiding certain angles in photos?

Yeah, I do. Before I send out any event pictures or... or join a video meeting with vendors, I'll just keep checking my face in my phone camera. I end up retaking photos a lot, or I'll try to tilt my head a certain way so it doesn't look as bad. Sometimes I even ask a coworker if I look weird. I don't mean to, but... doing all that can eat up enough time that I fall behind on my planning stuff.
Have you ever felt this way about another part of your body before, or has it always been mostly about your nose?

No, not really. It's pretty much always been my nose. I mean, sure, everyone has days where they don't love how they look, or maybe they don't like their hair or whatever, but... no, I've never felt this way about anything else. I've never fixated on another part of my body like I do with this. It's just always been my nose.
